description: This file defines an Android activity class 'Tabs1' that demonstrates the use of tabs with labels and associated views within a TabActivity. It inflates a layout, and adds three tabs with specified indicators and content views.

classes.name: Tabs1
classes.description: An Android activity extending TabActivity that creates a tabbed interface with three tabs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and sets up three tabs with labels and associated views.
